Q30.target: V100 GPUs for the GAN model

V100: RAG models and BART baselines are trained using 8, 32GB NVIDIA V100 GPUs.
adversarial nets: Adversarial nets are a framework where a generative model is pitted against a discriminative model that determines if a sample is from the model distribution or the data distribution.
Adversarial nets can be implemented using multilayer perceptrons for both the generative and discriminative models.
Adversarial nets using multilayer perceptrons can be trained using backpropagation and dropout algorithms.
Generative adversarial nets are trained by simultaneously updating the discriminative distribution.
The adversarial nets framework does not require a Markov chain for sampling.
The authors trained adversarial nets on the MNIST, Toronto Face Database (TFD), and CIFAR-10 datasets.
The title of the document is Generative Adversarial Nets.
generative adversarial: Generative adversarial nets are trained by simultaneously updating the discriminative distribution.
